name: refactor-pro
description: Safely refactor huge legacy codebases with a policy-driven workflow: intake / analysis / safety-net / wave-plan (single human approval) / gated autonomous execution / final verification. Behavior preservation via characterization tests and golden masters, deterministic shell gates (build / test-ratchet / lint-ratchet / scope / golden / size), adversarial LLM verification, a Chesterton's-Fence ledger for code nobody understands, and full resume support from an in-repo .refactor/ state directory.
